scope: External browser on actual published Pages app; only its pinned status response was controlled for this negative expiry case.
initialSetupFailure: First controlled status used Python ISO timestamps with a timezone offset/microseconds rather than the status contract's canonical UTC format. The client refused that invalid status, so waiting for the different expired-service message timed out. Correcting only the test response to canonical UTC reproduced the intended expiry case and passed; no application source changed.
